response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) as overall_avg_price FROM InvoiceLine), invoice_data AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), invoice_with_deviation AS (SELECT id.InvoiceId, id.Country, id.invoice_avg_price, id.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_avg_price as deviation_from_overall FROM invoice_data id CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), country_avg_deviations AS (SELECT Country, AVG(deviation_from_overall) as country_avg_deviation FROM invoice_with_deviation WHERE Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Country) SELECT iwd.InvoiceId, iwd.Country, iwd.invoice_avg_price, iwd.deviation_from_overall, iwd.deviation_from_overall - cad.country_avg_deviation as deviation_minus_country_avg FROM invoice_with_deviation iwd LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON iwd.Country = cad.Country ORDER BY iwd.deviation_from_overall - cad.country_avg_deviation DESC LIMIT 10
